name: DFL Staff Portal
_comment_start_url: Was https://dflhq.com/ — but the site root serves index.html, the REP APP, so installing 'DFL Staff Portal' from the hub gave you an app that opened Sales. It now opens the hub, which is what managers and admins land on. There are three installable apps and each has its own start_url: this one (hub), manifest-sales.json (/index.html) and manifest-merch.json (/merch.html).
_comment_shortcuts: Long-press the installed DFL Portal icon to open these directly (Android/desktop). This app's scope covers the whole site, so on Android Ask DFL can't be installed as a second app beside it; the shortcut gives managers a one-tap way in, and can be dragged to the home screen as its own icon.

shortcuts.name: Ask DFL
shortcuts.description: Ask about customers, products, prices, stock and sales
